name: systemfsoftware
description: System F Software — Effect-TS libraries and the oxlint plugin that enforces the constitution.

scripts.gate:tasks: pnpm test:scripts && pnpm guard:projects && turbo --concurrency=${TURBO_CONCURRENCY:-50%} --continue lint lint:tsgo typecheck test test:types attw api:check check
scripts.guard:projects: for g in check-project-membership check-typecheck-build-mode check-single-plan; do deno run --config=scripts/deno.jsonc --allow-read --allow-run --allow-write=${TMPDIR:-/tmp} --allow-env scripts/guards/$g.ts --selftest && deno run --config=scripts/deno.jsonc --allow-read --allow-run --allow-write=${TMPDIR:-/tmp} --allow-env scripts/guards/$g.ts || exit 1; done
scripts.check:ci: s=0; pnpm format:check || s=1; TURBO_CONCURRENCY=${TURBO_CONCURRENCY:-100%} pnpm gate:tasks || s=1; pnpm gate:dist || s=1; exit $s
scripts.check:local: s=0; ./bin/dprint check || s=1; TURBO_CONCURRENCY=${TURBO_CONCURRENCY:-100%} pnpm gate:tasks || s=1; pnpm gate:dist || s=1; exit $s
